task.description:
Update documentation and requirement statuses for WF-02 batch-5 (PIN-03, PIN-04, PIN-05, PRM-01 in Stage 16). TEST-RUNNER passed 6/6 steps. RELEASE-VALIDATOR awaits requirement status transitions before it can APPROVE.

IMPORTANT: Do NOT set requirements to RELEASED — only to TESTED. RELEASED requires an approved release decision from RELEASE-VALIDATOR, which will come after this step.

1. Transition requirement statuses to TESTED:
   python3 tools/reqctl.py set-status PIN-03 TESTED --implemented-in src/engine/pin_resolver.zig --implemented-in src/engine/instance.zig --implemented-in tests/integration/pin03_no_fallback_to_latest_version_test.zig
   python3 tools/reqctl.py set-status PIN-04 TESTED --implemented-in src/engine/instance.zig --implemented-in tests/integration/pin04_pin_resolution_replay_subprocess_test.zig
   python3 tools/reqctl.py set-status PIN-05 TESTED --implemented-in src/api/routes/pin_rebind.zig --implemented-in tests/integration/pin05_explicit_instance_pin_rebind_test.zig
   python3 tools/reqctl.py set-status PRM-01 TESTED --implemented-in src/definition/promotion_plan.zig --implemented-in src/api/routes/promotions.zig --implemented-in tests/integration/prm01_promotion_plan_diff_report_test.zig

2. Regenerate the rendered status file:
   python3 tools/reqctl.py render-status

3. Update CHANGELOG.md with this batch's changes. Read the existing CHANGELOG.md to understand the format, then add an entry for Stage 16 batch-5 covering:
   - PIN-03: No fallback to latest version (pin resolution uses pinned version, not latest)
   - PIN-04: Pin resolution on replay and in sub-processes (child inherits parent pins, conflicts recorded)
   - PIN-05: Explicit instance pin rebind (new INSTANCE_PINS_REBOUND event type, GET /api/v1/instances/{id}/pins, POST /api/v1/instances/{id}/pins/rebind)
   - PRM-01: Promotion plan and diff report (new promotion plan subsystem)

4. Run retrospective per estimation.yaml + actuals (you have the estimation in handoffs/WF02-batch-5-20260812/estimation.yaml). Calculate actual durations from handoff created_at/completed_at timestamps. Write retrospective to scratch/retrospective-WF02-batch-5-20260812.md.

5. Update the handoff file:
   - status: "COMPLETED"
   - result.status: "PASS" (this step only fails on tool errors, not on release-approval decisions)
   - completed_at: (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString("yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ")
   - result.summary: what you did
   - result.artifacts_out: updated docs/status/requirement_status.yaml, updated CHANGELOG.md, retrospective file path
acceptance_criteria: PIN-03, PIN-04, PIN-05, PRM-01 all set to TESTED in requirement_status.yaml
CHANGELOG.md updated with Stage 16 batch-5 entry
